description: This file is a React component for displaying a comprehensive Model Hub dashboard with sections for Models, Agents, and MCP Servers. It handles data fetching, modals for detailed views, and admin actions like making models/agents/mcp servers public.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to display detailed information about a selected model.

methods.name: showAgentModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to display detailed information about a selected agent.

methods.name: showMcpModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to display detailed information about a selected MCP server.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the provided text to the clipboard and shows a success notification.

methods.name: formatCapabilityName
methods.description: Formats a support feature key into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getModelCapabilities
methods.description: Extracts the capabilities supported by a model as an array of feature keys.

methods.name: formatCost
methods.description: Formats a number representing cost per 1 million tokens into a dollar string.

methods.name: handleMakePublicSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes model hub data after a successful public operation.

methods.name: handleMakeAgentPublicSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes agent data after a successful public operation.

methods.name: handleMakeMcpPublicSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes MCP server data after a successful public operation.

methods.name: handleFilteredDataChange
methods.description: Updates the filtered model data state when filters are changed.
